story.title: Cookie learns to share
paragraphs_en: Cookie the dog lives with Sahana, Priya, Mom and Dad. Cookie loves Sahana and Priya, and they love her too. They take good care of Cookie and enjoy playing with her. Sahana is Priya's older sister. She likes sharing her things with Priya.
Cookie is confused this morning. She notices that something is different. Everyone at home looks very excited. Sahana and Priya whisper every time Cookie comes close to them.
Cookie wants to ask Mom what is going on? But, Mom and Sahana say, “Bye Cookie, we will be back soon.” And, they drive off. Dad is making snacks for Priya and Cookie so, they wait by the window.

Cookie dashes to the front door when she hears it open. She stops halfway and sniffs. Is it a treat for me?” “Look Cookie, we have a friend for you. Her name is Tootsie. Do you like her?” Asks Priya showing Tootsie to Cookie.
Cookie sniffs, gently touches Toostsie, turns away and says. “I like her. But, is she going to live with us forever? I hope not.”

After a few days Cookie knows that Tootsie is going to stay. Tootsie says, "Please play with me Cookie." But, Cookie doesn’t want to play or share any toys or treats. She is used to playing and sharing with just Sahana and Priya.
Cookie wonders, "Will Sahana and Priya love Tootsie more than they love me?” She thinks, "Do I have to share my toys and share Sahana and Priya with Tootsie?"

After a while, Cookie begins to play with Tootsie. Cookie realizes that Sahana and Priya will always love her. They have enough love to give to Tootsie too. Very slowly, Cookie learns to care for Tootsie and share some of her treats and favorite toys.

Tootsie asks Cookie, " Can we be friends?" "We are more than friends," says Cookie. "We are a family, and I will share my things with you just like Sahana shares with Priya. Now I know that sharing is caring."
